subject: Competitive bake-off recap - OmniHealth evaluation & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap - OmniHealth evaluation & next steps

Sarah - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery / kickoff so we’re all aligned and can move to a short bake-off: 

Pain points you shared:
- Inference cost at scale (current spend is trending up as telemetry and notes volumes grow).
- High tail latency on embedding & chat endpoints during peak windows - needs to be <200ms P95 for key flows.
- Strict security/compliance: SOC 2 + VPC isolation and customer-managed KMS for PHI-sensitive workloads.
- Fragmented routing across clouds and occasional model fallbacks causing inconsistent outputs.

Goals for the evaluation:
1) Demonstrate 2–3x cost reduction on typical embedding workloads while meeting latency SLAs.
2) Validate private deployment options / network controls and key management.
3) Confirm functional parity vs your incumbent (AtlasAI) for clinical summarization and search use cases.
4) Produce a decision matrix covering latency, cost, reliability, and operational fit.

Proposed bake-off plan (attached):
- 2-week side-by-side test using an anonymized sample of 100k documents you provide (we’ll work with your security team on the scrubbed export).
- Test cases: embedding search at 3 query QPS, chat summarization at realistic session lengths (avg 250 tokens), and a long-tail stress run for P95/P99.
- Metrics: throughput, P50/P95/P99 latency, total tokens & cost, model output quality on a scored prompt set.
- Redwood will supply: pre-configured inference endpoints (hosted + private preview), a recommended quantization profile, and a bake-off matrix template.

Open questions / asks for you:
- Confirm stakeholders who should be in the kickoff (CTO, InfoSec, and a systems person for VPC/networking).
- Can you deliver a scrubbed dataset or a synthetic equivalent by next Wed (3/4)?
- Any non-standard compliance requirements beyond SOC 2 and an external pen test?

Next steps:
- If that plan looks good, propose we lock a 45-min technical kickoff Monday 3/1. Rafael will join on commercial items and I’ll coordinate the test plan. Dev, can you prep a baseline config we can spin up immediately?

Attachments: omnihealth-bakeoff-matrix-20260227.xlsx (bake-off matrix), redwood-bakeoff-plan-20260226.pdf (detailed test plan)

Thanks - looking forward to it.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: redwood-bakeoff-plan-20260226.pdf]

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@omnihealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@omnihealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap - OmniHealth evaluation & next steps

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear write-up. That matches our internal notes and I appreciate the concrete test plan. A few clarifications: 

- Stakeholders: yes - please include Tom (CTO) and Priya Natarajan (Head of Compliance). I’ll loop Priya separately once we have the scrubbed dataset / NDA in place.
- Dataset: we can provide a scrubbed export of ~80–120k clinical notes by next Wednesday (3/4). Our security team requires a simple DPA/NDA before sharing - can you send your DPA (or a link to your security portal)?
- Success criteria: cost & latency are top, but we’ll also be scoring model outputs on clinical correctness (3 reviewers, blind scoring).

We’re running a parallel evaluation with AtlasAI and a small in-house baseline. We’d appreciate if Redwood can:
1) Include a short run showing the impact of quantization on quality (intended vs quality delta).
2) Provide an expected cost per 1M tokens for both hosted and private deployment options (ballpark is fine for now).

Kickoff: Monday 3/1 at 10am PT works for most of us. Could you confirm and send an invite?

Thanks -
Sarah
Senior Product Manager, Search & Insights | OmniHealth
[sarah.chen@omnihealth.com]

[Forwarded message header shown when team needs it]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@omnihealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap - OmniHealth evaluation & next steps

Sarah - perfect, thanks. Confirming the kickoff: Monday 3/1, 10:00 AM PT - I’ll send the calendar invite now. Quick notes ahead of the call: 

- DPA/NDA: Rafael - can you share the standard DPA link and a short SOC2 summary to Sarah? (cc’d)
- Quantization test: Dev - we’ll run three profiles (fp16 baseline, 4-bit quant with load tests, and a mixed-precision option) and include a quality-delta table so OmniHealth can see trade-offs.
- Cost estimates: Rafael - please include preliminary hosted vs private per-1M-token estimates in the kickoff deck. We’ll flag optional reserved capacity pricing in case they want predictable throughput.
- Data handling: Sarah - once we have the DPA in place, we’ll provide S3 ingestion instructions and a scrub checklist for your security team. We’ll also supply an automated anonymizer script if needed.

Immediate ask for OmniHealth: please upload the scrubbed export or synthetic equivalent to the Drive link below by 3/4 EOD so Dev can get baseline runs queued.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d5e6f7g/view
Kickoff invite: sent (calendar invite attached)

Thanks - talk Monday.

-
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: OmniHealth bake-off - internal tasking

Team - internal follow-up after Sarah’s reply and kickoff confirm. Keeping this tight so we can act fast: 

Rafael:
- Share DPA link & SOC2 summary with Sarah by EOD today.
- Draft a simple hosted vs private cost slide (ballpark numbers + reserved capacity options) for Monday’s kickoff.
- Flag any commercial concessions we want to offer for an evaluation (trial credits, short-term reserved pricing) - propose in thread.

Dev:
- Prep three baseline endpoints (fp16, 4-bit, mixed) and run an initial 1k-doc embedding pass once we receive the dataset. Capture P50/P95/P99 and per-token cost for the run.
- Script for anonymizer / S3 ingestion - prioritize ease-of-use for OmniHealth security team.

I’ve attached the bake-off matrix and plan for your reference. Let’s sync quickly after the kickoff for task handoff.

-
Marissa
